title: The Asia reversal usually lands between 20:00 and 22:00 ET

hero.caption: of Asia sessions carve a clean down-then-up reversal. When they do, the turn clusters in the **20:00–22:00 ET** window.

chart.label: When the reversal lands — by 2-hour block (ET)
chart.note: Median bounce out of the low is 46 points. By 23:00 ET it's basically over.

useIt: Just over half of Asia sessions reverse. When they do, the turn usually lands 20:00–22:00 ET — earlier or later is rarer. The sweep-low still has to form and hold before any of this matters.
